## Professional Summary
Full-stack developer with production experience shipping features used by government allocation systems, enterprise helpdesks, and consumer-facing web applications. Works across the full stack—MERN stack, React/TypeScript frontends, PHP/Node.js backends, and MySQL/MongoDB/PostgreSQL databases—with a primary focus on systems that handle real organizational complexity: role-based access control (RBAC), multi-step workflows, performance optimization, and audit trails.
